description: PAID $0.25 USDC. Every current product variant of one Shopify store in the index with price, compare-at price, stock flag, SKU, tags, URL and image. Store list is free at /v1/free/ecom/stores. Returns JSON for every current variant of that store: price, compare-at price, stock flag, SKU, tags, URL, and image.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

domain.description: Shopify store domain. Format: a hostname, no scheme. Example: allbirds.com. Required. The free store list is /v1/free/ecom/stores.

name: ecom_catalog
title: E-commerce full store catalog ($0.25)
